name: Power Word Stun
summary: Stuns a creature with 150 Hit Points or fewer, or reduces its Speed to 0 otherwise.

stats.effect:
You overwhelm the mind of one creature you can see within range. If the target has 150 {ref:glossary/hit-points} or fewer, it has the {ref:condition/stunned} condition. Otherwise, its {ref:glossary/speed} is 0 until the start of your next turn.

The {ref:condition/stunned} target makes a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on itself on a success.
